task.title: Setting-Up the FM Transmitter in Your Car
task.shortdesc: To begin using the device, you need to set it up to your car's radio station.

context.p: Setting up the device includes plugging the device into your car and channeling an unused radio frequency. A video tutorial for the set-up is also provided here.

step.note: You can typically find unused stations at the high-end or low-end of your car's station dial.
step.cmd: Tune the car radio to an unused FM radio frequency.

fig.title: Figure 1: Car radio tuned to an unused FM frequency

image.alt: Image of a car radio on an unused FM frequency

step.note: LED Display will automatically turn on when plugged in.
step.cmd: Plug in the device into your car's cigarette lighter or power port.

fig.title: Figure 2: Device plugged into the car power port

image.alt: Image of transmitter plugged into car's power port.

step.cmd: Locate and Press the CH Channel Button.

fig.title: Figure 3: CH Channel Button on the FM transmitter

image.alt: Image of device with CH Channel Button labeled

step.cmd: Toggle the Multi-Function Button left/right to match the device's radio frequency to the pre-selected frequency on your car radio.

fig.title: Figure 4: Matching the transmitter and radio frequencies

image.alt: Image of matching frequency of car radio and transmitter

result.p: The car radio is successfully connected to the device if there is no static or interference.If there is still static "noise", repeat the steps using a different unused frequency.
